productConcept.name: GRUNDFORM
productConcept.tagline: Structure is teachable. Form is the lesson.
productConcept.description: A Bauhaus-rooted design workshop school in Stuttgart, Germany, founded 1969. Teaches structural typography, visible grid systems, geometric composition, and analogue print methods before any digital tool is introduced.
productConcept.rationale: The prime-grid design system is explicitly Bauhaus/Constructivist: asymmetric 5-column grid with visible 2px gaps, Bebas Neue 900 at 120px, primary color structural blocks (red/blue/yellow), linear motion throughout, and press-displacement active states. A design workshop school is the most direct institutional expression of these values — teaching the philosophy IS the product. The caller's recommendations specifically named Bauhaus/design school as the target territory.
